# LibGuides at University of North Florida

> UNF Library's comprehensive research and subject guide platform providing access to databases, resources, and library services for the University of North Florida community.

LibGuides at UNF serves as the central hub for research resources, subject-specific guides, and library services at the University of North Florida. The platform integrates access to academic databases, digital collections, and library information through an organized guide system powered by Springshare.

- [Library Impact Dashboard](https://libguides.unf.edu/impact): Library Impact Dashboard showing usage statistics and research resource metrics
